stories.title: Zverev dashes American hopes, beats Shelton in US Open final for 2nd major
Murray's Vikings debut ends early as QB suffers concussion
stories.summary: Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray suffered a concussion after taking a hard hit in his Minnesota debut.

stories.title: U.S. wins fifth straight women's hoops World Cup
stories.summary: Breanna Stewart scored 22 points, Jackie Young added 18 and the U.S. beat France 97-79 to win its fifth consecutive women's FIBA World Cup championship.

stories.title: Texas rises to No. 1 as Ohio State and Oregon fall; Michigan back in Top 25
stories.summary: The unprecedented comeback by Texas to knock off Ohio State moved the Longhorns to No. 1 in the AP Top 25 and pushed the Buckeyes out of the top five for the first time in two seasons.

stories.title: Titans fall flat in coach Saleh's debut as Ward struggles
stories.summary: The Titans suffered a miserable 23-10 loss to Robert Saleh's former team, the Jets, while quarterback Cam Ward had a tough outing, completing 19 of his 32 pass attempts for 140 yards and one touchdown.
